newsitem.title: USA: Nevada Gold sets gold reserve development.
newsitem.headline: Nevada Gold sets gold reserve development.

text.p: Nevada Gold & Casinos Inc said Friday it signed an operating agreement with Coromandel Resources Ltd to develop Nevada Gold's gold reserves in the Goldfield mining district in Esmeralda and Nye counties, Nevada.
Under the agreement, Nevada Gold said, it received an undisclosed initial cash payment and will receive 100,000 Coromandel shares plus monthly minimum payments against a five percent royalty.

Coromandel will spend $5 million to develop the reserves and Nevada Gold has the right to re-acquire up to a 49 percent working interest in the project by reimbursing Coromandel a proportional share of its expenditures.
